viewing_check: Armitage current bid $160, next bid $165, estimate 60-100 (bid already well above estimate). Kit matches the typical eBay sale: laser, receiver, clamp and case; used RL-H4C kits sold A$570-785 over 3 years (typically A$600-700), so even at A$300-350 there is margin if it works. Dirty and well used, the Pentax level is a bonus (not priced). Check at viewing: power on, beam rotation, auto-level (the bubble/lock), receiver beeps, battery compartment, laser window scratches, any damage to the case. Stock sales are Terapeak 3 years, no sale older than Dec 2023 shown.
